proposals.before: His father Xun had passed the jinshi examination and served as a judicial reviewer in Taiping Prefecture before being promoted to Palace Attendant and appointed transit commissioner of Guangzhou.
proposals.after: His father Xun had passed the jinshi examination and served as a judicial reviewer in Taiping Prefecture, then as Palace Aide (dianzhong cheng) and controller-general (tongpan) of Guangzhou.
proposals.reason: 殿中丞 is a palace-administration aide, not 'Palace Attendant'; 通判 is controller-general/vice-prefect, not transit commissioner (轉運使).

proposals.before: His father Xun passed the jinshi examination, served as judicial reviewer in Taiping Prefecture, and was promoted to Palace Attendant and concurrently administered Guangzhou as transit commissioner.
proposals.after: His father Xun passed the jinshi examination, served as judicial reviewer in Taiping Prefecture, and as Palace Aide concurrently served as controller-general of Guangzhou.
proposals.reason: Same office errors as the idiomatic line: 殿中丞 and 通判 are mistranslated.

proposals.before: Daofu died later, at the age of eighty-nine.
proposals.after: Xun later died, at the age of eighty-nine.
proposals.reason: The notice sits at the close of the father's career and is followed by Daofu's childhood; Song biography formula records the father's death here. Naming Daofu contradicts the continuing life narrative.

proposals.before: Later Daofu died at the age of eighty-nine.
proposals.after: Later Xun died at the age of eighty-nine.
proposals.reason: Same contextual mismatch: 後…卒，年八十九 after the father's retirement should record Kong Xun's death, not Daofu's.

proposals.before: Because his impeachments were judged improper, he was sent out to administer Yan Prefecture and later transferred to Qing Prefecture.
proposals.after: Because his impeachments were judged improper, he was sent out to administer Yun Prefecture and later transferred to Qing Prefecture.
proposals.reason: 鄆州 is Yun Prefecture, not Yan (兗州).

proposals.before: Because his impeachment matters were improper, he was sent out to administer Yan Prefecture and then transferred to Qing Prefecture.
proposals.after: Because his impeachment matters were improper, he was sent out to administer Yun Prefecture and then transferred to Qing Prefecture.
proposals.reason: 鄆州 is Yun, not Yan.

proposals.before: The emperor sent Zonggu out to serve as transit commissioner of Laizhou.
proposals.after: The emperor sent Zonggu out to serve as controller-general of Laizhou.
proposals.reason: 通判 is controller-general/vice-prefect, not transit commissioner.

proposals.before: The emperor sent Zonggu out as transit commissioner of Laizhou.
proposals.after: The emperor sent Zonggu out as controller-general of Laizhou.
proposals.reason: 通判 is not 轉運使.

proposals.before: The emperor was indeed angered and, charging Daofu with factionalizing on behalf of a great minister, sent him out to administer Yan Prefecture.
proposals.after: The emperor was indeed angered and, charging Daofu with factionalizing on behalf of a great minister, sent him out to administer Yun Prefecture.
proposals.reason: 鄆州 is Yun Prefecture; Yan is 兗州, which appears later for Kong Zonghan.

proposals.before: The emperor was indeed angry and, on the grounds that Daofu was in faction with a great minister, sent him out to administer Yan Prefecture.
proposals.after: The emperor was indeed angry and, on the grounds that Daofu was in faction with a great minister, sent him out to administer Yun Prefecture.
proposals.reason: Literal English also renders 鄆州 as Yan, colliding with 兗州.

proposals.before: Wang Gui and Sima Guang both memorialized in his favor. He rose from transit commissioner of Ling Prefecture to transport judge of the Kuizhou Gorge circuit, then served as intendant of criminal justice in the eastern capital circuit and as administrator of Qian Prefecture.
proposals.after: Wang Gui and Sima Guang both memorialized in his favor. He rose from controller-general (tongpan) of Ling Prefecture to transport judge of the Kuizhou Gorge circuit, then served as intendant of criminal justice in the eastern capital circuit and as administrator of Qian Prefecture.
proposals.reason: 通判陵州 is tongpan of Ling, not transit commissioner (轉運使).

proposals.before: After Qinruo's death, Censor-in-Chief Wang Zhen memorialized for Yong's restoration as Palace Attendant Censor and appointment as Salt and Iron Commissioner of the Three Departments.
proposals.after: After Qinruo's death, Censor-in-Chief Wang Zhen memorialized for Yong's restoration as Palace Attendant Censor and appointment as Salt and Iron judge of the Three Departments.
proposals.reason: 三司鹽鐵判官 is a judge/assistant, not the Salt and Iron Commissioner (使).

proposals.before: Chao Jiong recommended him as transit commissioner of Yi Prefecture, and Lü Yijian, pacification commissioner of the Sichuan Gorges, also praised his ability. He was promoted from Erudite of the Imperial Ancestral Temple to Right Rectifier.
proposals.after: Chao Jiong recommended him as controller-general of Yi Prefecture, and Lü Yijian, pacification commissioner of the Sichuan Gorges, also praised his ability. He was promoted from Erudite of the Imperial Ancestral Temple to Right Rectifier.
proposals.reason: 通判 is controller-general or vice prefect, not transit commissioner (轉運使).

proposals.before: Several months later he was punished for having served as Kaifeng's examination patrol officer without properly scrutinizing candidates who had exchanged examination answers in private. He was demoted to supervise Jizhou taxes and later transferred as transit commissioner of Jin Prefecture.
proposals.after: Several months later he was punished for having served as Kaifeng's examination patrol officer without properly scrutinizing candidates who had exchanged examination answers in private. He was demoted to supervise Jizhou taxes and later transferred as controller-general of Jin Prefecture.
proposals.reason: 通判晉州 is controller-general of Jin Prefecture, not transit commissioner.

proposals.before: Several months later, because he had once been Kaifeng's examination patrol officer and failed to scrutinize candidates, privately exchanging examination answers, he was demoted to supervise Jizhou taxes and later transferred as transit commissioner of Jin Prefecture.
proposals.after: Several months later, because he had once been Kaifeng's examination patrol officer and failed to scrutinize candidates who privately exchanged examination answers, he was demoted to supervise Jizhou taxes and later transferred as controller-general of Jin Prefecture.
proposals.reason: 私以策辭相授 refers to candidates colluding, not to Liu Sui exchanging answers; 通判 is not transit commissioner.

proposals.before: After Wang Qinruo's death, an edict ordered his image cast at Mount Mao and enrolled among the immortal officials.
proposals.after: After Wang Qinruo's death, an edict ordered his image sculpted at Mount Mao and enrolled among the immortal officials.
proposals.reason: 塑 means to sculpt or model an image, not to cast metal.

proposals.before: Before long he was appointed acting judge of the Bureau of Internal Appointments, where he enforced the longevity regulations so strictly that clerks could not commit fraud.
proposals.after: Before long he was appointed acting judge of the Bureau of Internal Appointments, where he enforced the Changding personnel regulations so strictly that clerks could not commit fraud.
proposals.reason: 長定格 is the Changding fixed personnel-grading statute, not longevity regulations.

proposals.before: Before long he was acting judge of the Ministry of Personnel's Bureau of Internal Appointments; he conducted affairs by the longevity regulations, and clerks could not commit fraud.
proposals.after: Before long he was acting judge of the Ministry of Personnel's Bureau of Internal Appointments; he conducted affairs by the Changding regulations, and clerks could not commit fraud.
proposals.reason: Literal likewise renders 長定格 as longevity, which misreads the statute name.

proposals.before: In antiquity the Three Excellencies did not strike subordinates. In the previous reign, when Chen Shu posted a man's name at the Secretariat, he was dismissed at once.
proposals.after: In antiquity the Three Excellencies did not strike subordinates. In the previous reign, when Chen Shu had a man flogged at the Secretariat, he was dismissed at once.
proposals.reason: 榜人 is parallel to 按吏 (beating clerks); posting a name invents a notice and misses the beating.

proposals.before: Miao Shunchen, registrar of the Directorate of Astronomy, and others reported that the Earth Lodging lingered in the Three Enclosures and that the planet Venus appeared in daylight. The throne ordered the court astronomers to investigate jointly.
proposals.after: Miao Shunchen, registrar of the Directorate of Astronomy, and others reported that Saturn lingered at the Shen lodge and that Venus appeared in daylight. The throne ordered the court astronomers to investigate jointly.
proposals.reason: 土宿留參 is Saturn lingering in the Shen lunar lodge, not Earth Lodging in the Three Enclosures.

proposals.before: Their report held that the Earth Lodging's lingering in the Three Enclosures was harmonious and not inauspicious;
proposals.after: Their report held that Saturn lingering at the Shen lodge was compliant and not mutually offensive;
proposals.reason: Repeats the 土宿留參 mistranslation from the previous sentence.

proposals.before: He was ordered to stop it.
proposals.after: An order was given to stop it.
proposals.reason: 命罷之 refers to rescinding the feather-purchase order, not ordering Xiugu personally to stop.

proposals.before: After some time he was sent out to administer She Prefecture, transferred to Nanjian Prefecture, and later reappointed judicial commissioner of Kaifeng.
proposals.after: After some time he was sent out to administer She Prefecture, transferred to Nanjian Prefecture, and later reappointed judge of Kaifeng Prefecture.
proposals.reason: 開封府判官 is a prefectural judgeship, not the circuit office of judicial commissioner.

proposals.before: that his brother Weiji, serving as observation commissioner and overall commander of Ding Prefecture, had requested transfer to remain in the rear;
proposals.after: that his brother Weiji, serving as observation commissioner and overall commander of Ding Prefecture, had requested to be moved in place to acting military governor;
proposals.reason: 留後 is the office of acting military governor, not a request to remain in the rear.

proposals.before: The Cao clan from Xiugu onward was known for straightforward integrity; its women also could avoid being burdened by profit; as for Jin, he could also die for his office; and Xiumu was content with official advancement, returning home without waiting for old age—the age therefore deemed them worthy.
proposals.after: The Cao clan from Xiugu onward was known for straightforward integrity; its women also could avoid being burdened by profit; as for Jin, he could also die for his office; and Xiumu was also indifferent toward official advancement, returning home without waiting for old age—the age therefore deemed them worthy.
proposals.reason: 恬於仕進 means being indifferent to advancement, not content with advancement.

proposals.before: The Guo clan has no great fault and ought not be deposed.
proposals.after: The Guo empress has no great fault and ought not be deposed.
proposals.reason: 郭氏 here continues the remonstrance about Empress Guo, not the Guo clan as a whole.

proposals.before: He was transferred to Attendant-in-Chief of the Palace Secretariat, declined and did not accept, but requested posthumous grant for his grandfather Ning, magistrate of Laiyang, and was therefore made Vice Director in the Ministry of Rites' Bureau of Temples.
proposals.after: He was transferred to Attendant-in-Chief of the Palace Secretariat, declined and did not accept, but requested a posthumous grant for his grandfather Ning, magistrate of Laiyang, who was then made Vice Director in the Ministry of Rites' Bureau of Temples.
proposals.reason: 遂以為尚書祠部員外郎 follows the posthumous grant for the grandfather and records Ning's posthumous office, not Guo Quan's appointment.

proposals.before: When Lü Hui and other censors memorialized against the Secretariat's proposal to posthumously honor Prince Anyi of Pu, they were dismissed and Yuanming was appointed probationary Investigating Censor in their place.
proposals.after: When Lü Hui, Attending Censor in charge of miscellaneous affairs, and other censors memorialized against the Secretariat's proposal to posthumously honor Prince Anyi of Pu as ritually improper, they were dismissed and Yuanming was appointed probationary Investigating Censor in their place.
proposals.reason: The idiomatic sentence omits 御史知雜事 and 典禮非是.

proposals.before: When Zhang Shisun was posted to Jiangning he recruited Shaolian as transit commissioner. On returning to the capital he served as investigating officer in the Censorate and was promoted to Erudite of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
proposals.after: When Zhang Shisun was posted to Jiangning he recruited Shaolian as prefectural vice-administrator. On returning to the capital he served as investigating officer in the Censorate and was promoted to Erudite of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
proposals.reason: 通判府事 is a prefectural vice-administratorship, not a transit commissioner.

proposals.before: When Zhang Shisun guarded Jiangning he recruited him as transit commissioner of prefectural affairs; on return he became investigating officer of the Censorate and was transferred to Erudite of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
proposals.after: When Zhang Shisun guarded Jiangning he recruited him as vice-administrator of prefectural affairs; on return he became investigating officer of the Censorate and was transferred to Erudite of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
proposals.reason: Same mistranslation of 通判 as transit commissioner.

proposals.before: He was restored as erudite and transit commissioner of Tianxiong Army.
proposals.after: He was restored as erudite and vice-administrator of Tianxiong Army.
proposals.reason: 通判天雄軍 is vice-administrator of Tianxiong Army.

proposals.before: He again became erudite and transit commissioner of Tianxiong Army.
proposals.after: He again became erudite and vice-administrator of Tianxiong Army.
proposals.reason: Same mistranslation of 通判.

proposals.before: I grieve that Your Majesty treads the full beauty of benevolence and sagacity yet lacks bone-in-the-throat worthy assistants, thereby forming an unenduring anger and also delaying the not-distant return.
proposals.after: I grieve that Your Majesty treads the full beauty of benevolence and sagacity yet lacks bone-in-the-throat worthy assistants, thereby forming anger born of forbearance and also delaying a return that is not far off.
proposals.reason: 不忍之忿 is anger arising from forbearance (unwillingness to depose), not unenduring anger; 不遠之復 is a correction not far off, not an opaque return.

proposals.before: Before long he was appointed judicial commissioner of Kaifeng, promoted to Vice Director in the Ministry of Justice and academician of the Hall of Assembled Talents, made Treasury Commissioner of the Three Departments, and sent out as Vice Transport Commissioner of the Two Zhe circuits.
proposals.after: Before long he was appointed administrative assistant of Kaifeng Prefecture, changed to Vice Director in the Ministry of Justice and academician of the Hall of Assembled Talents, made administrative assistant for census of the Three Departments, and sent out as Vice Transport Commissioner of the Two Zhe circuits.
proposals.reason: 開封府判官 is a prefectural administrative assistant, not a judicial commissioner (提點刑獄); 改 means changed, not promoted; 三司度支判官 is a census assistant, not the Treasury Commissioner.

proposals.before: Before long he was appointed Kaifeng judicial commissioner, changed to Vice Director in the Ministry of Justice and direct academician of the Hall of Assembled Talents, made Treasury Commissioner of the Three Departments, and sent out as Vice Transport Commissioner of the Two Zhe circuits.
proposals.after: Before long he was appointed Kaifeng Prefecture administrative assistant, changed to Vice Director in the Ministry of Justice and direct academician of the Hall of Assembled Talents, made administrative assistant for census of the Three Departments, and sent out as Vice Transport Commissioner of the Two Zhe circuits.
proposals.reason: The same office errors as the idiomatic line: 判官 is not judicial commissioner or Treasury Commissioner.

proposals.before: When an innocent man died in Xiuzhou prison, the clerks in fear plotted to forge a confession. Before they could finish, Shaolian arrived in Hangzhou by boat, questioned the prison staff, and received their full confession. They took him for a divine judge.
proposals.after: When an innocent man died in Xiuzhou prison, Shaolian was then in Hangzhou. Clerks in fear plotted to forge a confession; before they could finish, Shaolian had already entered the city by boat, questioned the prison staff, and received their full confession. They took him for a divine judge.
proposals.reason: Chinese 時少連在杭 already places him in Hangzhou; 舟入城 is his arrival in the city (of the Xiuzhou case), not arrival in Hangzhou.

proposals.before: The commentary says: The ancients had a saying: "When a mountain has fierce beasts, the wild greens are not picked for it."
proposals.after: The commentary says: The ancients had a saying: "When a mountain has fierce beasts, the wild greens are on that account not picked."
proposals.reason: 為之不采 means the greens are not gathered because of the beasts, not picked 'for it'.

decisions.reason: 殿中丞 is a palace-administration aide, not Palace Attendant, and 通判 is controller-general, not transit commissioner.
The same 殿中丞 and 通判 errors appear in the literal line; Palace Aide holding the Guangzhou tongpan is the sense of 以殿中丞通判廣州.
Received Songshi names 道輔 as the subject of 卒; CText and Wikisource both read 後道輔卒，年八十九. Rendering that as Xun silently emends the chapter instead of translating it.
The literal Chinese likewise names 道輔. Wikisource Songshi 297 matches CText; changing the name to Xun is a source emendation, not an English repair.
鄆州 is Yun Prefecture; Yan transcribes 兗州.
Literal 鄆州 is likewise Yun, not Yan.
通判萊州 is controller-general of Laizhou, not transit commissioner (轉運使).
The literal line repeats the 通判/轉運使 confusion.
出知鄆州 again names Yun Prefecture, not Yan.
Literal 鄆州 must be Yun, matching the idiomatic repair.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 以道輔朋黨大臣，出知鄆州

decisions.reason: 由通判陵州 is promotion from tongpan of Ling, not from transit commissioner.

decisions.reason: 三司鹽鐵判官 is a salt-and-iron judge/assistant, not the commissioner (使).
薦通判益州 recommends him as controller-general of Yi, not transit commissioner.
通判晉州 is controller-general of Jin Prefecture.
私以策辭相授 is the candidates' collusion that he failed to detect, and 通判 is not transit commissioner.

decisions.reason: 塑其像 is to model or sculpt an image, not to cast it in metal.
長定格 is the Changding personnel-grading statute, not a longevity rule.
The literal line makes the same misreading of 長定格 as longevity.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 以長定格從事，吏不得為奸

decisions.reason: 中書榜人 is parallel to 三公不按吏 and means flogging a man at the Secretariat, not posting a name.
土宿留參 is Saturn lingering at the Shen lodge, not an Earth Lodging in the Three Enclosures.
The memorial repeats 土宿留參，順不相犯, which is Saturn at Shen, compliant and not in mutual offense.
命罷之 rescinds the feather-purchase order; it does not order Xiugu himself to stop.
開封府判官 is a Kaifeng prefectural judgeship, not a circuit judicial commissionership.
自請就遷留後 requests in-place promotion to acting military governor (留後), not a posting to remain in the rear.
恬於仕進 is indifference to advancement, the opposite of being content with office-seeking.
郭氏 continues 郭皇后廢 and means the Guo empress, not the Guo clan as a whole.
遂以為尚書祠部員外郎 follows the requested 贈 for grandfather Ning and records that posthumous office, not Guo Quan's appointment.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 請贈其祖萊陽令寧，遂以為尚書祠部員外郎

decisions.reason: The original drops Lü Hui's title 御史知雜事 and the charge 典禮非是, both present in the Chinese.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 御史知雜事呂誨等奏彈中書議追崇濮安懿王典禮非是

decisions.reason: 辟通判府事 is recruitment as prefectural vice-administrator, not as transit commissioner.
Literal 通判府事 is the same vice-administratorship, not a transit post.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 張士遜守江寧，辟通判府事

decisions.reason: 通判天雄軍 is vice-administrator of Tianxiong Army.

不忍之忿 is anger born of forbearance, not unenduring anger; 不遠之復 is a return/correction not far off.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 因成不忍之忿，又稽不遠之復

decisions.reason: 開封府判官 is a prefectural assistant, 改 is a change not a promotion, and 三司度支判官 is a duzhi assistant, not Treasury Commissioner.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 除開封府判官，改尚書刑部員外郎、直集賢院，為三司度支判官

decisions.reason: Literal 判官 titles are likewise assistants, not a judicial or treasury commissioner.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 除開封府判官……為三司度支判官

decisions.reason: 時少連在杭 already places him in Hangzhou; 舟入城 is his boat entry into the (Xiuzhou) city, not arrival at Hangzhou.

decisions.reason: 藜藿為之不采 means the greens are not gathered because of the beasts, not picked for the mountain.
